Cifrato reads, classifies, and reconciles, then hands you only what needs a human eye.

Brings in every invoice

Pulls invoices straight from the tax authority and email automatically, as they arrive.

Learns from real company context

Classifies and posts each document against the right accounts, taxes, and cost centers.

You approve the exceptions

Only the entries that genuinely need a human decision are surfaced for your review.

Syncs into your financial software

Posts the finished entries straight into the ERP your team already runs.

Accounting that drives growth

Turns the closed books into live reports and signals leadership can act on.

The engine built for the work.

Anyone can wrap a language model. Very few can run a country's accounting and be trusted with the books.

Legacy ERPs, connected

Mapped the connection path for every major accounting system. We write straight into the systems companies already run.

Teach it, then trust it

Nothing posts without human sign-off. Every entry is traceable to its source, audit-grade trust, not a black box.

Learns from what it sees

Every invoice booked makes the next one more accurate. The more we run, the harder we are to catch.

Built to be trusted with the data

Your data never trains public models. The engine learns patterns, never your books. Every entry traceable to its source.
